stack: Hermes agents on Claude (Atlas on Opus, workers on Sonnet)
Git repos with crew guard hooks
assumptions: Stefano reaches Atlas through Telegram; card wakes do not reach the desktop app.

files.name: Telegram chat with Atlas
files.description: Where Stefano sends a brief and answers Atlas's questions.

files.name: Atlas's rules
files.description: How the lead plans, asks, builds the hardest piece and hands out cards.

files.name: Card playbook
files.description: The card template, branches, ownership checks and merge steps.

files.name: Batch file
files.description: Stefano's words verbatim, decisions, defaults and the cards for one batch.

files.name: Settled taste calls
files.description: One line per verdict Stefano gave; never reopened unless he does.

files.name: Mason's rules
files.description: Builds one card inside its owned files and commits on its crew branch.

files.name: Argus's rules
files.description: Checks what can be checked on a card and passes it or sends back one finding.

files.name: Crew guard
files.description: Refuses any agent commit or merge outside crew branches.

files.name: Blocked commands
files.description: Stops every agent from pushing, publishing or throwing away work.

endpoints.name: Ask Stefano
endpoints.description: Atlas's question round; Stefano taps an answer.

endpoints.name: Hand out a card
endpoints.description: Puts one bounded job on the studio board for Mason.

endpoints.name: Ask for review
endpoints.description: Mason hands the finished card to Argus on the same card.

endpoints.name: Preview deploy
endpoints.description: A private preview link Stefano can click; never the public site.
